【Azazel Gamble】Steam Global Launch!​​
​All Players Are Demons · Psychological Slaughter​
​Dynamic Difficulty · Plot Twists​
​Blank Ammo Mechanic · Lies Are Weapons​
"More intense than Werewolf, more cerebral than Script Murder!"
​Team Up Tonight – Dare to Reveal Your "Demon Identity"?​​

​Identity Gambit: Devils in the Details​

​4 players, 1 demon (Azazel)​​ randomly chosen per round.
​Demons​ wield 3 cards from a pool of ​​[Chaos, Curse, Explosive]​​ and unleash ​1 lethal attack per turn.
​Civilians​ hold survival tools like ​​[Healing, Restraint, Dodge]​, but ​50% of their bullets are blanks​ – trust no one!


​Blank Ammo Mechanic​

​50% chance of misfires​ – even civilians might accidentally shoot teammates!
​Dynamic outcomes: From "Demon Party" to "Savior’s Rise", every choice reshapes the ending.
